Silver Tempest Trainer Gallery

Released November 11, 2022 · 30 cards

StandardExpanded

Silver Tempest Trainer Gallery is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on November 11, 2022. It has 30 cards. It includes 24 Pokémon, 6 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

19 illustrators worked on Silver Tempest Trainer Gallery. Most cards: KIYOTAKA OSHIYAMA (3), nagimiso (3), AKIRA EGAWA (2), Hideki Ishikawa (2), HYOGONOSUKE (2), PLANETA Mochizuki (2), Ryuta Fuse (2), saino misaki (2).
